purpose: Replay the deterministic rule-based topological global planner at every sealed C08 frame without controlling a robot, before any M-TARE closed-loop replacement.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-5 shadow replay over 3 C08 development worlds, 4773 unique frames, 5 frozen semantic methods and 23865 planner cycles; no new sensing, inference, training, C09/C10 or robot control.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed: 现在继续推进,定好一个目标我要把整个流程跑出来; bound only to the already-presented next immutable C08 Gate-5 shadow run.

raw_sources: Three sealed C08 sensor/graph coordinate streams and frozen B0, M1D seeds 0/1/2 and GT-oracle semantic streams.
The C08-frozen causal graph tuple sf2_tr8_lr6_hh20_te45_da20.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local C08 development shadow replay only; no M-TARE benchmark or strict-test data.

sampling.rule: Replay every sealed frame once for each of five frozen semantic methods. The 23865 method-frame planner cycles are repeated evaluations, not independent samples.

teacher.source: GT oracle is an integrity comparator only. The planner consumes current/past causal graph state and never consumes evaluator GT edge identity, future frames or the complete TNG.
teacher.valid_mask: Every emitted waypoint must be finite, remain within the 4m map-frame handoff radius and route only through trace-verified graph edges.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Shadow decisions are logged but never sent to /way_point. Empty frontier state is CANDIDATE_COMPLETE and cannot publish exploration_finish without a later independent stability/coverage confirmation.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 development assets are read. C09 is not used to revise planning parameters and C10 remains sealed.

estimated_cost.compute: One CPU process in the frozen Torch/Zarr sidecar; two deterministic replays per method/world; zero GPU, sensing, inference or training.

evidence.machine_metrics: Fifteen complete JSONL decision traces, per-method/world status/mode/churn metrics, deterministic hashes and aggregate summary.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No selected-image claim is needed for this interface gate; every decision remains machine-readable and later graph/trajectory visualization must be generated from the complete traces.
evidence.failure_policy: Any input/tool/environment drift, nonfinite or over-radius waypoint, unverified route edge, nondeterministic replay, wrong count or C09/C10/M-TARE closed-loop read is immediate FAIL with no retry or parameter change.
